notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run retriage-drivers-1-049) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null. No human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, and no MuJoCo engine, upstream environment, simulator or robot run is claimed.

CARD AND ENTRY: both card entry symbols exist in the pinned clone: drloco.mujoco.mimic_walker3d:MimicWalker3dEnv at drloco/mujoco/mimic_walker3d.py:27 and drloco.mujoco.mimic_walker_165cm_65kg:MimicWalker165cm65kgEnv at drloco/mujoco/mimic_walker_165cm_65kg.py:20. The card's decision (family-config, helper MujocoDriver, family mujoco) is the shape used; there is no deviation from the card. MimicWalker3dEnv selects the card's models[0], drloco/mujoco/xml/walker3d_flat_feet.xml (mimic_walker3d.py:38), and the package serves that model through MujocoDriver. The model file is read in place from the read-only clone; it is not copied or imported. The upstream environment was not imported or run: it extends gym's MujocoEnv (mimic_env.py:18), its reference-trajectory base imports collections.Iterable (drloco/ref_trajecs/base_ref_trajecs.py:2), and the card's family/helper point at the MJCF.

WHAT IT SERVES: cap.world.step.v1 {ticks, action: {ctrl: [8 numbers]}} writes data.ctrl and calls mj_step, and cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData + mj_forward. The model has three COM slides, three trunk hinges and four leg joints (14 qpos and 14 qvel values) and eight motor actuators (walker3d_flat_feet.xml:18-23, 28-37, 50-59, 71-80). The global default motor element states ctrllimited=true, ctrlrange -300 300, gear 1 and forcerange -300 300 (walker3d_flat_feet.xml:6-10), so the bridge derives action.ctrl per element from that model range and refuses an out-of-range value with MHS.SAFETY.ENVELOPE_VIOLATION before writing data.ctrl. No Limit is declared and no actuator is operator_required, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. The model option sets the RK4 integrator and timestep 0.001 s (walker3d_flat_feet.xml:11), which is the served 1.0 ms lockstep step. reset restores the model defaults, including com_z at its ref of 1.08 (walker3d_flat_feet.xml:20), and a reset seed is accepted but MuJoCo reset does not use it.

NOT COVERED: the upstream environment layer is not served. Its step takes a policy action clipped to [-1, 1] and rescales it by the action space (mimic_env.py:170-192); its observation concatenates the phase variable, desired speed, qpos and qvel (mimic_env.py:403-431); its reward and termination use the DeepMimic reward and the COM z / ep_dur_max conditions (mimic_env.py:116-126, config/hypers.py:55-58); and its reset starts from reference-trajectory qpos/qvel with a ground-contact shift (mimic_env.py:526-559). The MuJoCo bridge instead exposes the model step and its integration state and takes the model's raw control vector. The package serves only the card's models[0]; drloco/mujoco/xml/walker3d_hip3d.xml and drloco/mujoco/xml/walker_165cm_65kg.xml are not loaded. Camera, inertial, contact-force and sensor arrays and rendering are not served. No physical walker is modelled or driven.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: MuJoCo and mujoco-py are not installed and cannot be installed here (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is the package-local stand-in mujoco module FakeMujoco in fake.py (declared as the imported class, as the other MuJoCo packages do). It parses the pinned MJCF for the 14 joints, their qpos0 refs, the eight actuator targets and the inherited default ctrlrange, but its per-tick motion is a placeholder and it loads no geom, contact, inertia, damping, actuator force or sensor; it has no mj_getState/mj_setState/mj_stateSize, so the bridge uses its basic checkpoint profile. The fake publishes the F0 contract 'analytic:stand-in mujoco module (no physics)' with the model's 1.0 ms timestep; the class-level F1 contract describes the real mujoco path, which was not run. A backend name that backends does not list (sim) imports the real mujoco module and loads the same file; that path was not run. No trajectory was compared with the real engine.

WARNINGS LEFT BY THE LAST GATE RUN, all expected and none failing: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND for the simulator-family stand-in (the G7 message wording says 'upstream simulator itself', but this fake is an analytic stand-in for the mujoco module, not the upstream simulator); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed. PLAYBOOK.md section 8 treats these simulator-family warnings as expected. No G4.REF_VALUE, G4.REF_BINARY or other G4 warning was raised. The gate's G1 passed, so the read-only clone was not modified.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds nine cases (model shape from the card model, default ctrlrange refusal with zero effect, control-vector length, step advancing the integration state, step without an action, reset to model defaults, basic snapshot/restore, published fidelity, e-stop latch); all pass. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. The upstream licence is NOASSERTION and publication review is required; this pass is not a publication decision. The digest above is the digest line of the last gate run.
